confirmed_gap: The prior adapter read only the legacy unsuffixed error-class target while new procedures were stored at content-hash-suffixed targets. Previously APPLIED generated procedures therefore did not enter the next review prompt through that path. Exact byte deduplication alone did not cover paraphrases.
behavior: Before provider execution, reuse the module index and existing bounded verified reader to supply all currently indexed APPLIED procedures with skill_id, target, SHA256 and complete body. Reviewer context reads emit neither skill_loaded nor procedure_used.

Prefer applicable existing skills: same cause/applicability/action with mere rewording returns no candidate; a useful refinement requires explicit update_target and update_pre_sha256; genuinely distinct causes, conditions or corrective actions retain the existing content-hash create path.

Revalidate the supplied catalogue, full bytes, settings and applicable active self-owner after the provider returns. Overflow, unsafe paths, drift and unavailable bodies fail closed before proposing a change.

An update must name an exact supplied eligible target@SHA. Case-insensitive protected targets and registered machine-action lessons cannot be refined by the generic reviewer. The existing module retains preSHA apply, backup and rollback.

Exact duplicate body anywhere in the supplied catalogue is a no-op after update identity validation; updating A to B's exact existing body does not erase A or create a duplicate. Invalid updates never fall back to creation.

Canonical apply/content remain compatible; optional update identity is a pair. Reject missing/null/unknown/duplicate/case-aliased fields, nonobjects and trailing payload. Persist only fixed safe reviewer failure categories.

hermes_reuse.pattern: Existing suitable skill first; fresh full read before update; create only when no suitable class-level skill exists; preserve provenance and lifecycle.
hermes_reuse.adaptation: AirWorker preserves its own protected/native-action policy and reuses module v0.1.1 index, propose/apply, backup and rollback. Hermes permissions to edit bundled skills are not imported.

verification.scope: Actual adapter and existing learning module fixture paths, including content-hash apply/update/backup/rollback/idempotence, stale/foreign/protected/native-action/strict-response negatives, and prior learning delivery/action regression.

coordinator_corrections: Reject missing/null/case-aliased required model-answer fields rather than silently counting malformed JSON as no_candidate; retain canonical two-field compatibility.
Pin Hermes update-first/fresh-read reference and explicit context/eligibility boundaries in README.

evidence: HEAD matches the requested SHA. The four changed source files match the coordinator QA summary’s SHA256 hashes.

The adapter supplies complete target, SHA, skill ID, and body for every indexed APPLIED procedure, including content-hash targets. It rejects count, size, and changed-body failures before provider invocation and records no load/use event for context reads.

Update responses require an exact supplied target and preSHA, fresh settings/catalogue/bytes, and applicable active self-owner. Protected and registered machine-action bodies are excluded. The module fixture verifies apply, backup, rollback, idempotence, and preservation of an unrelated procedure.
Strict response parsing rejects missing, null, duplicate, unknown, and case-aliased fields while retaining legacy two-field responses. Fixed failure reasons withhold injected detail.
